inspiration: Tiny indexed-palette creature sheets (rat 16x15, goo 20x14, DM-300 25x22 frames): a 3-4 tone palette with one accent is a cheap, readable mob look for our originals.
Goo and DM-300 use particle emitters for spray and supercharge sparks (GooSprite.java, DM300Sprite.java): a short burst on charge-up telegraphs an attack without new art.
One tile sheet per biome (sewers, caves, city, halls, prison, crystal, gnoll): each zone gets its own palette and wall set from the same tile system.
One shared effects atlas (effects/) with speck layers and fireball variants: VFX reuse a single atlas, which keeps draw calls and art work small.
Music is calm, tense and boss variants per zone (music/): a three-state music set per zone is a clear pattern to copy with our own tracks.
Splash panoramas per biome (splashes/): large loading-screen art, one per zone, reads as place identity at a glance.
Title banner with a separate glow layer (interfaces/banners.png, per docs/recommended-changes.md): a glow layer over a base title is a cheap, reusable effect.
